The '''Manufacturers' District''' was a street lined with factories in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Xakrea]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. During the [[Mission to Darkknell (New Sith Wars)|Mission to Darkknell]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]]'s pursuit of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and [[Odionate]] mercenary [[Narsk Ka'hane]] took her through the area. After overpowering and stealing the Bothan's [[Stealth suit/Legends|stealth suit]], Kerra's location meant that she had to walk past the destroyed [[Daimanate Dynamic Testing Facility|Black Fang]] facility on her way home to the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gub Tengo]]'s home, where she worked as a part-time tutor for his daughter [[Tan Tengo]].
